_comment: Mages guild layer for 3s. gp1 = Umbra %, gp2 = Concentration % (both out of 100), fed by katmud_lib/mage.py from the prompt (Umb:/Cnc:) and GMCP Guild.State; the status line under the bars shows bridges, imbues and school spells (count + reset %), the guild reset %, and the active protections from the prompt's second line. The prompt layout is the player's own (confhp), so every field is optional. MIP/FFF is gone mud-side (2026-09-15). Cascade rule REPLACE (character file wins).
No warning colours on Umbra/Concentration yet - whether high or low is bad is unknown.
Attack: requires an explicit target ('kill <mob>'); plain 'kill' won't work. autoattack_command left empty so Hunt parses the room and sends 'kill <keyword>'.
